strings.name: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
strings.summary: Trained in zoology and brewing, Mazumdar-Shaw founded Biocon in 1978 after encountering gender barriers in employment. She led its shift from industrial enzymes to biopharmaceuticals, developing research services and international partnerships. Her career connects fermentation technology, medicine manufacturing and access to care, alongside biotechnology education.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: By founding Biocon, she advanced Indian biopharmaceutical research and production, influencing medicines, manufacturing and access to healthcare.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Zoology degree, Bangalore University (1973); malting and brewing training in Ballarat, Australia (1975).
strings.highlights.h1.title: From enzymes to biopharmaceuticals
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led Biocon's extension of fermentation technology into therapeutic products including insulin.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Research and training
strings.highlights.h2.text: Developed research services and partnered with KGI in bioscience professional education.
strings.timeline.t1.title: KGI honorary degree
strings.timeline.t1.text: Named honorary-degree recipient and keynote speaker at the commencement ceremony.
strings.timeline.t2.title: World Entrepreneur award
strings.timeline.t2.text: Received EY's World Entrepreneur of the Year award for her entrepreneurial biotechnology career.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Othmer Gold Medal
strings.timeline.t3.text: Honored for her contributions to India's biotechnology industry.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Biocon flotation
strings.timeline.t4.text: The company completed an IPO as it developed into an integrated biopharmaceutical business.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Developing Syngene
strings.timeline.t5.text: Biocon established a research-services subsidiary supporting drug discovery.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Founding Biocon India
strings.timeline.t6.text: Partnered with Ireland's Biocon Biochemicals, initially producing industrial enzymes.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Completing brewing training
strings.timeline.t7.text: Qualified as a master brewer in Australia, building a foundation in fermentation.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completing zoology studies
strings.timeline.t8.text: Earned her zoology degree at Bangalore University.
